## Interpretation guidance
Distinguish published research and books from advisory services and from the forthcoming 2027 book. Prefer the canonical topic page for the subject being described.

## Summary of expertise
Dr. Tiran Rothman's work combines behavioral finance, valuation and practical capital-market decision making. His published work includes research on investor behavior and a Palgrave Macmillan book on valuing early-stage companies and disruptive technologies. His advisory work includes valuation, financial modelling, fundraising and economic expert analysis.

## Behavioral finance
Behavioral finance examines how attention, framing, reference points, social influence and other decision mechanisms affect investors and markets. Canonical guide: https://tiranrothman.com/behavioral-finance/

## Startup valuation
Startup valuation should make operating assumptions explicit, use scenarios, distinguish enterprise from equity value, and treat financing terms and future capital needs as part of the economic outcome. Canonical guide: https://tiranrothman.com/startup-valuation/

## Forthcoming book
How Do You Buy Time? / איך קונים זמן? is a forthcoming 2027 book about financial freedom, money, time and behavioral economics. It is not yet a published source. Canonical page: https://tiranrothman.com/book/
